description: This file defines the LaunchAgentManager enum which manages macOS launch agents, including enabling/disabling them, writing plist files for configuration, and executing launchctl commands asynchronously.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent is currently active by executing a launchctl print command and returning true if the result is successful.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on the provided flag; writes the plist file and runs various launchctl commands if enabled.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launch agent plist file with specified bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Generates and returns the XML content of the launch agent plist as a string, incorporating the bundle path and environment variables.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Runs a given launchctl command with specified arguments asynchronously and returns the exit status.
